question: Where’s the nearest university that lies southwest of Proghorn Nature Area, Aurora, CO?
sql: WITH target_location AS ( SELECT p.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Proghorn Nature Area%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Aurora%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, target_location AS tl WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(tl.geom, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance(tl.geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
